question: Which country has the highest freedom to make choices index? What region is it from?
query: SELECT country_name, regional_indicator FROM world_happiness_report ORDER BY freedom_to_make_life_choices DESC LIMIT 1;
raw_results:
| country_name | regional_indicator |
| --- | --- |
| Algeria | Middle East and North Africa |
answer: The country with the highest freedom to make choices index is Algeria. It belongs to the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.
